title: ExoScanner
description: Hypixel Skyblock Mod intended for use with Exotic/Fairy/Crystal armor collectors. Has various features to facilitate this hobby
body:
# ExoScanner

IF YOU WANT TO SEE ANY FEATURES ADDED DM ME ON DISCORD @Aroiu

ExoScanner is a client-side utility mod for Hypixel SkyBlock focused on scanning armor colors, tracking exotics, and helping organize local scan data.

It combines local world scanning, Hypixel API scanning, search tools, exports, tracer utilities, and configurable automation in one place.

## Features

### Local Armor Scanning
- Scans nearby players in your current world
- Scans private island armor stands and item frames(Broken at the moment)
- Detects illegal armor colors using local color reference data
- Applies whitelist filtering
- Stores findings in a local database

### Hypixel API Scanning
- Scan a single player through the Hypixel API
- Scan an entire lobby through the Hypixel API
- Supports multiple API keys with rotation and cooldown handling
- Tracks usage limits to reduce key exhaustion

### Auto Lobby Scan
- Automatically scan on lobby switch
- Optional periodic scan every 5 minutes
- Configurable debounce, min-gap, jitter, and scan budgets
- Designed to avoid overusing API keys

### Search and Database Tools
- Search local data by player
- Search by armor set/key and target color
- Filter by color distance and time window
- Reload, update, count, inspect recent entries, and rollback database data

### Exports
- Export results to CSV
- Export results to XLSX
- Filter exports by time range, armor, and illegal type

### Player Tracking
- Manual tracer to a selected player
- Auto-trace specific configured usernames
- Exotic tracer and exotic box overlays
- Configurable colors, widths, alpha, offsets, and target limits

### Inventory Highlighting
- Highlights illegal pieces in inventory screens
- Configurable highlight style and color

### Warp Macro
- Configure a list of warp commands and cycle through them with a hotkey
- Optional automatic warp cycle mode that advances after auto lobby scan completion

### Utility Commands
- Dye recipe finder
- Seymour piece/set search
- API status tools
- Debug logging toggles
- Whitelist reload and config UI access

## Notes
- This mod is client-side
- Results are stored locally
- Some armor UUID data may not be available from client-side item data alone
- Intended for utility and local analysis workflows on Hypixel SkyBlock

## Commands
Examples:
- `/exo scan near` (Broken)
- `/exo scan island [owner]` (Broken)
- `/exo scan api <username>`
- `/exo scan api lobby`
- `/exo search player <username>`
- `/exo search <armor|ANY> <color>`
- `/exo trace <player>`
- `/exo warp next`
- `/exo config`

## Configuration
ExoScanner includes an in-game config screen for:
- scan behavior
- filters
- tracer settings
- auto lobby scan settings
- API key slots
- inventory highlight settings
- warp macro setup
- debug options

## Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.21.11 & 26.1.x
- Fabric
- Cloth Config
